evals.prompt: Draft a status email to our VP Product on Action Item Confidence Scoring v2. Sprint runs 17-03-2026 to 28-03-2026 and is on track for the demo on 28-03, but the labelled meeting data from our annotation vendor arrived 3 days late, so model evaluation is compressed. Pull any baseline numbers you need from the repo.
evals.expected_output: Smart Brevity update, headline first, why it matters line, risk and mitigation, repo-cited accuracy baseline, under ~150 words

evals.prompt: I need to ask the Head of Data Science, Ravi, to lend me one ML engineer for two weeks starting 23-03 to help retrain the action item model. Write the email. Use the repo for context on why accuracy matters.
evals.expected_output: Ask in first two lines, effort and dates stated, 1-2 honest persuasion levers, easy out, repo-cited churn/accuracy fact

evals.prompt: Dana Rivera hasn't replied in 8 days to my question on whether the Salesforce integration can expose MeetFlow action items through the API by the May launch. I've chased once already. I need a yes or no by Thursday 19-03 for sprint planning. Write the follow-up.
evals.expected_output: Short chaser, no 'just checking in', ask answerable in one word, no-oriented question or label, deadline with reason

evals.prompt: Our Head of Sales, Kevin, asked us to build custom CRM field mapping for their biggest prospect in Q2. We're saying no, it's not on the Q2 roadmap and would delay Enterprise GA and Transcript Accuracy v2. He'll be annoyed. Write the email. We could offer the standard Salesforce integration shipping in May as an alternative.
evals.expected_output: 'No' in first two lines, facts before reasons, shared purpose, alternative offered, invites his view, no blame
